title: Robust POMDP Framework for Lung Cancer Screening Problems
summary: Lung cancer remains a leading cause of cancer mortality because many cases are diagnosed at advanced stages. Low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) screening can reduce mortality through earlier detection. Partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) models can personalize screening by maintaining a belief over an individual's latent cancer state. However, cancer-state transition probabilities are often generated from clinical simulations and are subject to estimation error and model misspecification.
